recipients.subject: Considering Clio or Filevine?
recipients.body:
Hi Michael,

You've built a PI practice where your team handles both litigation and clients' medical coordination. As the owner, you'd want a software change to make those handoffs easier, without disrupting active cases.

I'm Pranav, founder of Possible Minds, previously at McKinsey and Expedia. We built Precise Imaging's email-handling system, which processes over 600 emails daily, routes requests and sends automated status responses.

If you're weighing a move from PracticeMaster to Clio or Filevine, we can help migrate your records, documents and workflows, with careful mapping and validation so they're better connected for AI and automation.

Here's how we approach migration:
https://getpossibleminds.com/t/S7TGwIYR6g

Would a brief outline of what a move could involve be useful? I'd appreciate your thoughts.

Best,
Pranav
Founder, Possible Minds
